goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Set the guardrail “never give medical advice” on your agent’s persona.
Check your local rules on patient data before sharing health details in chat.

items.q: Will the agent give medical advice?
items.a: Not if you set the guardrail. Medical questions can be passed to your team instead.

items.q: Can it book appointments on WhatsApp?
items.a: Yes. The booking skill works on WhatsApp, your website and phone calls.

problems.title: What keeps a clinic phone ringing, and what your agent does about it.
problems.intro: Most patient questions are simple. They still take your front desk away from the patients in front of them.

items.scene: Timings, fees, parking. Your front desk answers the same calls between patients.
items.fix: Your agent answers clinic questions from your own information, on WhatsApp, your website and phone calls.
items.reply: Yes, from 9 to 1. Would you like to book?

items.pain: Bookings get lost in the back and forth.
items.scene: Three messages to agree a time, then the patient goes quiet.
items.fix: Your agent offers free times from your calendar and confirms the booking in one chat.
items.reply: Tomorrow has 11:00 or 4:30 free. Which suits you?

items.pain: Calls come after the clinic closes.
items.scene: At 9 at night a patient calls to book. Nobody picks up.
items.fix: The AI receptionist answers in English, Hindi and Telugu, and after hours a voicemail becomes a callback ticket.
items.ask: Hello, can I book a check-up?
items.reply: Of course. Saturday at 11 is free. Shall I book it?

items.pain: Patients ask medical questions in chat.
items.scene: Someone asks about their report. A wrong answer is not an option.
items.fix: Anything medical goes to your team with the conversation attached. Set a guardrail and your agent will not give medical advice.
items.reply: I will pass this to the clinic team. A doctor will reply.
